name: Midori
source:
Color: Green

Likes: Takkun,Festival,Teasing
Dislikes: School,Not doing Anything

Active,Laughing,Foolish - this will people tell if You ask them About Midori. Giggler whom on street you can't Meet in nothing But school uniform. But meeting her on street is Quite hard,You have Much-Greater chance to find her At forest,probably on some Branch. And if you are Lucky you'll Notice her before she Throws Something at you. But this Green Haired and Green Eyed Girl with tomboyish tendencies has suspiciously much flashes of seriousness and in her smile is too much sadness.
